scenes.title: The apology repeats

scenes.title: Where exploitation pays
scenes.viewerPurpose: See the inquiry reach people organizations and AI Understand how trust can be taken advantage of

scenes.title: Understanding without care
scenes.viewerPurpose: Picture a company knowing harm but not changing Distinguish recognizing vulnerability from caring
scenes.composition: A person’s concern reaches an interface but not the controlling policy
addOrChange: Add the unchanged rule as a separate modest document.

cues.narration: A company may know people are hurting while nobody has a reason to change its decisions.
cues.visualAction: Record the concern while the policy control stays untouched.

cues.visualAction: Show recognition in the interface without relief in the person’s situation.

scenes.title: Trust worth protecting
scenes.viewerPurpose: See room to protect trust without universal suspicion Ask how generosity can survive repeated exploitation
scenes.composition: Both people can inspect their shared exchange
addOrChange: Add one durable record without surveillance imagery or a perfect-defense claim.

cues.narration: The book asks how to protect trust without treating everyone as a potential enemy.
cues.visualAction: Continue cooperative work with the record visible to both.

cues.narration: Its deeper question is how cooperation can stay generous without leaving the door open to repeated harm.
cues.visualAction: End on a handoff either person can question.
